t: The Three O'Clock - Wikipedia
s: June 27, 2025 - Still signed to Frontier, the band issued the Baroque Hoedown EP, their debut release as the Three O'Clock, in late 1982. The EP was followed by an LP in 1984 entitled Sixteen Tambourines. Both Frontier releases were produced by Earle Mankey. The Three O'Clock had developed into a power-pop ensemble with 1960s garage band influences.
